text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on East Liberty Street, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services is requesting approval to prohibit standing at all times on certain sections of the north side of East Liberty Street, between Pirandello Street and the north-south leg of Western Battery Road. This is in response to complaints about vehicles blocking the fire route access and underground parking access for Liberty Village Town Homes (TSCC 1660, 1673, 1705, 1746) on the north side of East Liberty Street. This proposal would not result in the loss of any parking spaces. This report will address the fire route access and underground parking access for Liberty Village Town Homes on the north side of East Liberty Street. The fire route access for Liberty Village Town Homes on the west side of Pirandello Street will be addressed…

City Council on June 18 and 19, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council prohibit standing at all times on the north side of East Liberty Street, between a point 29.2 metres east of Pirandello Street and a point 14.5 metres further east, and between a point 99.3 metres east of Pirandello Street and a point 8.8 metres further east. 2. City Council rescind the parking machine regulation in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m., Monday to Saturday; and from 1:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m., Sunday, for a maximum period of three hours, on the north side of East Liberty Street, between a point 29.2 metres east of Pirandello Street and a point 14.5 metres further east, and between a point 99.3 metres east of Pirandello Street and a point 8.8 metres further east.
